record.bible_text: O LORD<WH03068>, thou <FI>art<Fi> my God<WH0430>; I will exalt<WH07311><WTH8787> thee, I will praise<WH03034><WTH8686> thy name<WH08034>; for thou hast done<WH06213><WTH8804> wonderful<WH06382> <FI>things; thy<Fi> counsels<WH06098> of old<WH07350> <FI>are<Fi> faithfulness<WH0530> <FI>and<Fi> truth<WH0544>.
